description: Draws connectors between existing elements by id; they stay attached when the elements move. Connectors attach to box, sticky and umlClass elements only (use an arrow element between other shapes, or give a free point {x, y} as an end). Ports default to the sides that face each other. relation gives UML arrowheads (inheritance, aggregation, composition, dependency). A connector cannot carry a label; to caption one, add a text element near it with board_add. The board is read first to check the ids exist. Changes appear live for everyone who has the board open.

boardId.description: Board id (a UUID) from board_list or board_create.

from.description: Id of a box, sticky or umlClass, or a free point {x, y}.

fromPort.description: Side the connector leaves from. Default: the side facing the other node.

relation.description: association (default), inheritance, aggregation, composition or dependency; UML arrowheads.

stroke.description: Outline colour #rrggbb. Default: blue on a light board, white on a dark one.

strokeWidth.description: Outline width in board units. Default 3.

to.description: Id of a box, sticky or umlClass, or a free point {x, y}.

toPort.description: Side the connector arrives at. Default: the side facing the other node.

name: board_connect
title: Connect elements on a Todrawn board
